sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **The plus sign of a model variant is now a term of its own.** It is neither a letter nor a digit, so the tokenizer dropped it and a catalogue writing "Realme 12+" indexed exactly what one writing "Realme 12" does. Coverage could then never tell the two apart, and the asymmetry ran the wrong way: a title spelling Plus as a word — for another phone entirely — covered the concept the shopper asked for, while the actual Plus did not. Measured on a 12 460-product parts shop, "realme 12 плюс акб" tied a battery for a different brand (its title carries "6 Plus" and a "12i") with the batteries for the phone that was named, and the wrong brand won the tie on score. The sign is now read the same way on both sides of the search, under the same boundaries the variant rule uses — a digit or a known modifier before it, neither a letter nor a digit after — so part numbers ("68+E", "HB444199EBC+") keep theirs and a spaced "+" in a title still lists what else is in the box ("Realme 9 Pro + OCA"). 379 of that shop's titles gain the term. The index schema is unchanged, so the upgrade drops nothing: the tables stay, search keeps answering from the terms already in them, and a background reindex rewrites each object in place — an install that never re-saves its catalogue would otherwise keep answering the old way forever. While that pass is still running, a query written with a "+" is answered by the objects already rewritten.
  • **A title that never names the model no longer outranks one that does.** The variant rule charged a title for every modifier the query named and the model lacks, but charged nothing at all when the model was absent from the title outright — on the reasoning that the match came from somewhere else. That put the stranger above the real thing: on the same shop "realme 12 pro+" ranked a connector for the Realme 3 and 5 — which owes its match to a "C12" elsewhere in its title — above the Realme 12 Pro parts, because those were charged for the missing Plus and it was charged for nothing. An absent model now costs exactly what a present one carrying none of the named modifiers costs. Measured on that shop: the connector falls from third to seventh and the Realme 12 Pro parts take third through fifth; a query naming no modifier is unchanged.
